summary: National database registration card providing ₹2 Lakh accidental insurance cover under PMSBY and social welfare eligibility.

steps.title: Check eligibility criteria
steps.description: Applicant must be an unorganized worker (construction, domestic, driver, agriculture) aged between 16 and 59, not in EPFO/ESIC.

steps.title: Register on e-Shram portal
steps.description: Authenticate via Aadhaar OTP, select primary occupation and sub-occupation from national skill list.

steps.title: Enter permanent address & nominee details
steps.description: Add emergency nominee name and relationship for accidental insurance benefits.

steps.title: Download 12-digit Universal Account Number (UAN) Card
steps.description: Instantly download digital PVC e-Shram card with photo and permanent UAN number.
